sources.result: connector rejected unsupported endpoint; board content unknown

claims.text: Conxian reuses external networks and has no own L1 or native Conxian token; Bitcoin remains the canonical trust/finality root.
Nexus observes/verifies; Gateway owns routing/ingress execution boundaries. Diagnostic registrations are not qualified chain/network/operation support.
Capability contract validation is structural and does not authenticate providers or authorize signing.
Wallet/provider and SDK hardware support remain operation-specific; no fleet-wide production qualification is inferred.
Public CAR intake verifies pinned source offline; live replication/operator independence remain unproven by that test.
Workflow state/audit rows persist transactionally; a fixture restored 34 rows across 18 tables on a second instance after stopping its source.
ITIL Version 5 defines eight lifecycle activities. Conxian R0–R5 are internal coordination workstreams, not the ITIL lifecycle.
Prefer portable recovery and workload-qualified independent operators before promoting decentralized providers to primary.
MeshLLM contains a Lightning payment proof of concept; unpublished mesh status alone does not enforce admission or attest runtime.
ERC-8004 discovery/reputation and BitVM3 result envelopes do not themselves establish payment settlement or cryptographic verification.
Project-v2 board contents, production recovery, actual commercial economics and independent release acceptance are not established by this snapshot.
